accepts.because: a first turn from a surface, for somebody this colony has not met yet. The caller MUST promote the identity to context.channel, and it MUST promote the round the conversation is spoken in to context.audience_set -- a JSON list in affinity vocabulary. The reception hands both to the ingress edge it draws into the composite it builds; it cannot derive the second from the first, because a channel identity is a room and not a participant. A caller that declares no round gets a generation that closes untagged, and a write path that needs one refuses that day visibly

emits.because: the greeting, or the handover for whoever takes over the conversation
the tree this reception decided to grow, as an ordinary mutation body. BOOTSTRAP ONLY -- no mutation can create the edge that carries it on to /colony/mutations

a step of this reception that the channel ledger did not answer (GH #343). hop.reject_reason is 'store_refused', hop.store_error carries the ledger's own error_code -- a free string, because the store's code list is open -- and hop.store_operation the refused op. Drain it: an unanswered lookup has the same shape as a channel nobody has met, and read as the second it used to grow a SECOND agent for a channel that already had one. The body names the STEP: at 'look' nothing is built and no row is written, so the same turn delivered again once the ledger answers is served correctly; at 'open' the agent was already built and the turn already left in the same emission, and only the ledger row is missing -- which makes every later turn on that channel repeat the instantiation, refused each time as a name collision

description.purpose: Scope marker of the reception: it holds the channel register and the one pass that reads it, behind a single entry lane. Everything that arrives from a surface goes through here exactly once per turn, and leaves on the lane of the channel it belongs to.
description.use_when: One per colony that serves more than one channel through the same kind of agent. Instantiate it in the same mutation that wires the ingress lane -- and grant the mutation lane in the parent's bootstrap config.json, because no mutation can create it.
description.not_in_scope: No conversation, no routing table of its own: the per-channel lanes are edges the reception itself draws, and they live in the parent scope's edge table like every other edge. Nothing is deleted -- a channel that fell silent keeps its row and its talky.
